full_text_zh:
[P1] 凯迪克大奖得主伍德夫妇作品
小猫怕怕
[美]奥黛莉·伍德 著/绘  王斌 译
神鸟
绘本
外语教学与研究出版社

[P2] 凯迪克大奖得主伍德夫妇作品
小猫怕怕
[美]奥黛莉·伍德 著/绘  王斌 译
我才不害怕呢。
我也不怕。
外语教学与研究出版社
北京

[P3] 哎呀，糟糕！没邮票了，
需要有人去一趟邮局。

一个忙忙碌碌的早上，猫妈妈坐下来写了封信。写完后，
她遇到了一个问题。

[P4] 点兵点将，点到谁就是谁。
你们谁愿意去趟邮局呢？
这次她会选
我俩的。
我也这样
觉得。
哦，选谁去呢？
就你吧，还有你。
不行，
我要去。
我也要去。
我，
让我去嘛。
我，我，
猫妈妈叫来七个孩子。哪两个到
城里去一趟，把信寄了呢？
小猫们争先恐后都想去。最后，猫妈妈
选中了年纪最大的两只小猫。

[P5] 呃！
呜呜呜……
你从来不选我们，妈妈！
呜呜呜……
这次
就让我们
去吧……
呜呜
呜……
两只最小的小猫非常伤心。他们从没离开过妈妈独自去城里，
为什么不给他们一次机会呢？

[P6] 小猫怕怕，小猫怕怕，
连只老鼠都捉不到呀！
哈，哈，哈哈哈！
我才不害怕呢！
我也不怕！
猫哥哥猫姐姐们放声大笑！让小
不点儿去城里？连个影子都能吓坏他
们。他们永远也到不了城里。
不过，猫妈妈是公平的。她知道
小猫宝宝说得对。毕竟，也该轮到他
们去了。

[P7] 好吧，你们俩沿着大路一直走，
到了邮局，买张邮票，
把这封非常重要的信寄了。

猫妈妈把信交给最小的黄猫宝宝，
又给了最小的蓝猫宝宝一枚硬币。

喵呜捉了只老鼠，
嗨哟嗨哟，
喵呜捉了只老鼠……

两只猫宝宝自豪地接过了信和硬币，
信心满满地出发往城里走去。

[P8] 前面的路看起来好像没有尽头。

[P9] 每走一步，小猫宝宝们就离家远一些，再远一些。

[P10] 那可就糟了。
突然，黄猫宝宝开始胡思乱想，担心会发生可怕的事。“万一发生糟糕的事情怎么办？万一你把妈妈的硬币丢了怎么办？”

[P11] 蓝猫宝宝表示同意，“要是我打个喷嚏，硬币从手里蹦出去怎么办？”
回来啊，硬币！
我虽不是“姜饼娃”，
滚得一样快快哒。♫
黄猫宝宝加了句，“它骨碌碌滚起来，越滚越快，越滚越快，越滚越快，可怎么办呀？”

[P12] 硬币硬币，
你在哪里？
硬币硬币，
快回来！
“然后它躲了起来，”蓝猫宝宝说，
“我们找不到它了，该怎么办啊？”
但是，担惊受怕的小猫们没有回头，他们继续沿着大路向城里走去。

[P13] 不一会儿，小猫们来到一座桥前。
突然，蓝猫宝宝开始胡思乱想，担心会发生可怕的事。“万一我们过桥时，
发生不好的事怎么办？万一有人偷走妈妈的硬币怎么办？”
好可怕啊。

[P14] 嗷呜！
我要把你们
当零食吃掉。
黄猫宝宝表示同意，"要是水里跳出个大猫怪，冲我们呜哩哇啦大叫怎么办？"
"要是他抓起我们乱晃，"蓝猫宝宝加了句，"要把我们吃掉怎么办？"

[P15] “要是他看到我们手里闪闪发亮的硬币，”黄猫宝宝说，“把它抢走了怎么办？

担惊受怕的小猫们很想转身回去，但他们还是决定继续往前走。”

[P16] 大恐怖了。
过桥到了对岸，两只小猫踮起脚尖走进森林。突然，黄猫宝宝开始胡思乱想，担心会发生可怕的事。"万一发生恐怖的事怎么办？万一我把妈妈的信弄丢了怎么办？"

[P17] “要是刮起大风，呼呼乱吹，”蓝猫宝宝表示同意，“把你手里的信吹走了，该怎么办？”
黄猫宝宝加了句，“要是大风把信吹进树叶堆里，可怎么办呀？”

[P18] 都找到头发花白，满脸胡子了，肯定很快就找到它了。
没错……
“万一我们找啊找，直到头发花白、满脸胡子还找不到，该怎么办啊？”蓝猫宝宝说。
虽然担惊受怕的小猫们很想转身回家，但是他们还是穿过了森林，继续向前走。

[P19] 太吓人了。
不一会儿，他们来到一条又长又黑的隧道前。
突然，蓝猫宝宝开始胡思乱想，担心会发生可怕的事。
“万一发生吓人的事怎么办？万一有人偷走了妈妈的信怎么办？”

[P20] 嘿, 嘿, 嘿!
嘘! 他们来了。
“要是猫强盗在里面等着我们怎么办？” 黄猫宝宝表示同意。
“要是他们的爪子像尖刀，” 蓝猫宝宝加了句，“血红的眼睛闪着寒光，可怎么办啊？”

[P21] 好冷啊。
我也冷。
“要是他们包围了我们，”黄猫宝宝说，
“用绳子把我们捆起来，扔在黑漆漆、
阴森森的寒冷的隧道里，该怎么办？”
尽管如此，担惊受怕的小猫们仍然
继续朝前走，穿过隧道，从另一头走了
出来。

[P22] 他们来到了一片荨麻地前。两只小猫走进高高高的荨麻丛。突然，黄猫宝宝开始胡思乱想，担心会发生可怕的事。“万一发生什么不幸的事怎么办？万一我们迷路了怎么办？”
太悲惨了。

[P23] 天灵灵地灵灵，
荨麻荨麻长不停！
小猫，小猫乖乖，
你们要到哪里去？
嘿嘿嘿……
救命啊！
救命啊！
“要是有只邪恶的猫巫婆念个咒语，”蓝猫宝宝表示同意，“把全世界
都变成荨麻地，该怎么办啊？”
“所有的猫和城镇都消失在了荨麻地里，”黄猫宝宝加了句，“我们永远也找不到邮局了，该怎么办呢？”

[P24] 担惊受怕的小猫们很想回家，
但还是穿过荨麻地向前走，来到了
又高又险的悬崖边。

突然，蓝猫宝宝开始胡思乱想，
担心会发生可怕的事。“万一发生悲
惨的事怎么办？要是有人把我们偷
走了怎么办？”

好怕怕。

[P25] 嘎嘎嘎。
“要是一只大鸟尖叫着抓住我们怎么办？”黄猫宝宝表示同意。
“要是它把我们抓到高山顶上的鸟巢里，该怎么办？”蓝猫宝宝加了句。

[P26] “而且，”黄猫宝宝说，“它还让我们照顾和喂它的丑八怪宝宝。”

[P27] 就算这样，担惊受怕的小猫们
还是继续向前走，没有走回头路。

小心脚下。
拉着我的尾巴。

看！
邮局在那儿！

我们过去吧！

成功啦！爬下悬崖后，两只小猫
就到了城里，轻松找到了邮局。

[P28] 猫总管生日，
今日停业！
哦，不！
连门都不开呢。
猫总管生日，
今日停业！
可是，当他们跑到邮局门前，一件真正糟糕、可怕、恐怖、吓人、悲惨、
不幸的事情发生了——邮局今天不营业。这样一来，妈妈的硬币买不成邮票了，
妈妈的信也寄不出去了。没完成妈妈交代的任务，小猫宝宝们可怎么回家啊？

[P29] 看看谁来啦。
外婆！
我们的问题
有办法解决啦！
就在这时，一辆公共汽车开了过来，车上走下来猫外婆。小猫们喜出望外，因为谁也不知道猫外婆要到猫城来。

[P30] 我们拿着
妈妈的
硬币和信。
猫怪，
狂风，强盗，
荨麻，
大鸟……
猫外婆看了看信，这次轮到她
吃惊了——信是写给她的！她打开
信，大声读了出来。
亲爱的猫外婆：
请到我家来做客吧，
小猫宝宝们想您了。
真诚的，
猫妈妈
小猫宝宝们把妈妈那封非常重
要的信一五一十地告诉了外婆，还
有那些可怕的事。

[P31] 哪一条路上有强盗？
带我去看看那只大猫怪。
你们俩说前面有个巫婆？
外婆，跟我们来。
我们认识路！
离开猫城之前，猫外婆带着小猫宝宝去了冰激凌店，给他们仨各买了一支鱼莓果冰激凌。

[P32] 终于，小猫们启程回家了，猫外婆紧跟在后面。一路上，他们胡思乱想着，担心会发生可怕的事——不过，他们没有那么害怕了。

[P33] 完
full_text_en:
[P1] Caldecott Medal-winning work by the Woods
Little Cat, Little Cat
[US] Audrey Wood, Author/Illustrator  Wang Bin, Translator
Shen Niao
Picture Book
Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press

[P2] Caldecott Medal-winning work by the Woods
Little Cat, Scaredy-Cat
[American] Audrey Wood, Author/Illustrator  Wang Bin, Translator
I'm not scared at all.
Me neither.
Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press
Beijing

[P3] Oh no, trouble! No stamps left.
Someone needs to go to the post office.

On a busy morning, Mom Cat sat down and wrote a letter. After finishing, she encountered a problem.

[P4] Pointing and choosing, whoever is pointed to is the one.
Who among you would like to go to the post office?
This time she'll pick
the two of us.
I think so too.
Oh, who should go?
You, and you.
No, I want to go.
I want to go too.
Me,
let me go!
Me, me,
Mom cat called her seven children. Which two will go to the city to mail the letter?
The kittens all rushed to volunteer. In the end, Mom cat chose the two oldest kittens.

[P5] Uh!
Wah wah wah...
You never pick us, Mommy!
Wah wah wah...
This time
let us go...
Wah wah
wah...

The two smallest kittens were very sad. They had never left Mommy to go to the city alone.
Why not give them a chance?

[P6] Little cats are scared, little cats are scared,
They can't even catch a mouse!
Ha, ha, hahaha!
I'm not afraid at all!
Me neither!
The older kittens burst out laughing! Letting the
little ones go to the city? Even a shadow could scare them.
They'll never make it to the city.
But Mommy Cat is fair. She knows
the little kittens are right. After all, it's their turn now.

[P7] Alright, you two go straight down the road,
get to the post office, buy a stamp,
and send this very important letter.

The cat mom handed the letter to the smallest yellow kitten,
and gave the smallest blue kitten a coin.

Meow caught a mouse,
Hey oh hey oh,
Meow caught a mouse……

The two kittens proudly took the letter and coin,
and confidently set off towards the city.

[P8] The road ahead seems to have no end.

[P9] With every step, the little kittens moved farther and farther away from home.

[P10] That would be terrible.
Suddenly, the yellow kitten started to worry, imagining terrible things. "What if something bad happens? What if you lose Mommy's coin?"

[P11] Blue kitten agreed, “What if I sneeze and the coin flies out of my hand?”
“Come back, coin!”
“I’m not a ‘gingerbread baby,’
but I can roll just as fast! ♫”
Yellow kitten added, “It rolls and rolls, faster and faster, faster and faster, faster and faster—what should we do?”

[P12] Coin, coin,
where are you?
Coin, coin,
come back quickly!
"Then it hid," said the blue kitten,
"We can't find it. What should we do?"
But the frightened kittens didn't turn back. They continued along the road toward the city.

[P13] In a little while, the kittens arrived at a bridge.
Suddenly, the blue kitten began to worry, thinking about terrible things. "What if something bad happens when we cross the bridge? What if someone steals Mommy's coin?"
"That's so scary."

[P14] Roar!
I'm going to eat you up for snacks.
Yellow kitten agreed, "What if a big cat monster jumps out of the water and roars at us?"
"What if he picks us up and shakes us around," added blue kitten, "and eats us up?"

[P15] "What if he sees the shiny coin in our hands?" said the yellow kitten, "What if he steals it?"

The frightened kittens really wanted to turn back, but they still decided to keep moving forward.

[P16] So scary.
After crossing the bridge to the other side, the two little cats tiptoed into the forest. Suddenly, the yellow kitten began to worry, thinking about terrible things. "What if something terrible happens? What if I lose Mommy's letter?"

[P17] "What if a strong wind blows, whirling around?" Blue Kitten agreed, "What if it blows your letter away?"
Yellow Kitten added, "What if the wind blows the letter into a pile of leaves? What then?"

[P18] We'll search until our hair turns white and our faces are full of whiskers; we'll surely find it soon.
That's right...
"What if we keep searching until our hair turns white and our faces are full of whiskers, and still can't find it?" said the blue kitten.
Although the frightened kittens really wanted to turn back home, they still crossed the forest and continued moving forward.

[P19] Too scary.
After a while, they came to a long, dark tunnel.
Suddenly, the blue kitten started to worry and imagine terrible things.
"What if something scary happens? What if someone steals Mom's letter?"

[P20] Hee, hee, hee!
Shh! They're coming.
"What if cat bandits are waiting for us inside?" agreed the yellow kitten.
"What if their claws are like sharp knives," added the blue kitten, "and their blood-red eyes flash with cold light? What then?"

[P21] It's so cold.
Me too.
"What if they surround us?" said the yellow kitten,
"Tie us up with ropes and throw us into the dark, 
creepy, cold tunnel? What then?"
Despite this, the frightened kittens still 
continued forward, through the tunnel, and emerged from the other end.

[P22] They arrived at a patch of stinging nettles. The two little cats walked into the tall nettle bushes. Suddenly, the yellow kitten began to worry, imagining terrible things. "What if something terrible happens? What if we get lost?"
Too terrible.

[P23] Tian ling ling, di ling ling,
Nettle, nettle, grow without stopping!
Little cats, little cats,乖乖,
Where are you going?
Hehehe...
Help! Help!
"If a wicked cat witch chants a spell," said Blue Kitten in agreement, "and turns the whole world into a nettle field, what should we do?"
"All the cats and towns would disappear into the nettle field," added Yellow Kitten, "and we'd never find the post office. What should we do?"

[P24] The frightened kittens really wanted to go home,
but they still walked through the stinging nettle patch and arrived at
a tall and dangerous cliffside.

Suddenly, the blue kitten started to worry and imagine worst-case scenarios,
fearing terrible things might happen. "What if something terrible happens? What if someone steals us away?"

Oh, so scary.

[P25] Gaa gaa gaa.
"What if a big bird screams and grabs us?" the yellow kitten agreed.
"What if it takes us to its nest on top of the mountain?" the blue kitten added.

[P26] "And," said the yellow kitten, "it even made us take care of and feed its ugly babies."

[P27] Even so, the frightened little cats
continued moving forward, not turning back.

Be careful of your feet.
Hold onto my tail.

Look!
The post office is over there!

Let's go!

Success! After climbing down the cliff, the two little cats
arrived in town and easily found the post office.

[P28] Cat Manager's birthday,
Closed today!
Oh, no!
The door won't even open.
Cat Manager's birthday,
Closed today!
But when they reached the post office, a truly terrible, awful, frightening, dreadful, tragic, and unfortunate thing happened — the post office was closed today. As a result, Mom's coins couldn't buy stamps, and Mom's letter couldn't be sent. Without completing Mom's task, how could the little kittens go home?

[P29] Look who's here!
Grandma!
Our problem
has a solution now!
Just then, a bus came by, and Grandma Cat got off. The kittens were overjoyed, because no one knew Grandma Cat was coming to Cat City.

[P30] We have
Mom's
coins and letter.
Cat monsters,
storms, robbers,
stinging nettles,
large birds...
Grandma Cat looked at the letter. This time it was her turn to be surprised—the letter was for her! She opened it and read it aloud.
Dear Grandma Cat:
Please come to our home as a guest.
The little kittens miss you.
Sincerely,
Mom Cat
The little kittens told Grandma everything about Mom's very important letter, and also all the scary things.

[P31] Which road has bandits?
Take me to see that big cat monster.
You two said there's a witch ahead?
Grandma, come with us.
We know the way!
Before leaving Cat City, Grandma Cat took the little kittens to an ice cream shop and bought each of them a fishberry ice cream.

[P32] Finally, the kittens started heading home, with Grandma Cat following closely behind. Along the way, they daydreamed, worrying about terrible things happening—yet, they were not as scared anymore.

[P33] The End
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《小猫怕怕》的封面，展示了两只紧紧依偎的小猫，一只橙色，一只蓝色，背景为黄色。封面上标注了作者、译者、出版社及“神鸟绘本”系列标识。
[P2] 本页为绘本《小猫怕怕》的封面，展示了两只紧紧依偎的小猫，一只橙色，一只蓝色，它们分别说“我才不害怕呢。”和“我也不怕。”，背景为浅色，上方有书名、作者、译者及出版社信息。
[P3] 猫妈妈写完信后发现没有邮票，需要有人去邮局，但她遇到了一个难题。画面中，猫妈妈坐在红色沙发上，周围是正在玩耍的几只小猫。
[P4] 猫妈妈召集七只小猫，询问谁愿意去邮局寄信，小猫们争先恐后地举手，最终猫妈妈选中了年纪最大的两只小猫。
[P5] 两只最小的小猫因未被选中去邮局而伤心哭泣，它们从未独自离开过妈妈，希望得到一次机会。
[P6] 画面左侧，几只较大的小猫嘲笑两只最小的小猫胆小怕事；右侧，猫妈妈抱着两只小猫，内心认为应该给它们机会，决定公平对待，让它们也去邮局。
[P7] 猫妈妈决定让两只最小的小猫去邮局寄信，并交给它们信和硬币。两只小猫接过任务后，信心满满地出发前往城里。
[P8] 两只最小的小猫手牵手走在通往城里的小路上，周围是秋天的风景，它们看着前方蜿蜒无尽的道路，显得有些犹豫。
[P9] 两只最小的小猫手牵手走在通往城里的小路上，表情有些犹豫和紧张，背景是秋天的森林和远处的家，它们正一步步远离家园。
[P10] 两只最小的小猫在前往邮局的路上开始感到紧张，黄猫宝宝胡思乱想，担心会出事或弄丢硬币，黑猫宝宝也显得焦虑不安。
[P11] 两只最小的小猫在去邮局的路上越走越紧张，蓝猫宝宝担心打喷嚏会弄丢硬币，黄猫宝宝则害怕自己像滚筒一样越滚越快失控，内心充满焦虑。
[P12] 两只最小的小猫在去邮局的路上丢失了硬币，它们焦急地寻找并互相呼唤，虽然害怕和担忧，但最终决定不回头，继续前往城里。
[P13] 两只最小的小猫来到一座桥前，蓝猫宝宝开始担心过桥时会发生可怕的事，比如硬币被偷，感到非常害怕。
[P14] 两只小猫在过桥时，因害怕水里跳出大猫怪而产生恐惧，黄猫宝宝和蓝猫宝宝分别想象了怪物出现和被吃掉的可怕情景。
[P15] 两只小猫在过桥时因害怕水中的怪物而感到恐惧，黄猫宝宝担心硬币被抢，但最终它们决定克服恐惧，继续前行。
[P16] 两只小猫过桥后进入森林，黄猫宝宝开始胡思乱想，担心会弄丢妈妈的信，感到非常害怕。
[P17] 两只小猫在森林中继续前行，蓝猫宝宝担心大风会吹走信件，黄猫宝宝则进一步想象信件被吹进树叶堆的糟糕情景，表现出对任务的持续焦虑。
[P18] 两只小猫在森林中继续前行，蓝猫宝宝担心找不到硬币，但它们最终克服恐惧，决定继续前进。
[P19] 两只小猫来到一条又长又黑的隧道前，蓝猫宝宝感到害怕并开始胡思乱想，担心妈妈的信会被偷走。
[P20] 两只小猫在进入隧道前，因害怕里面的猫强盗而产生恐惧，黄猫宝宝和蓝猫宝宝分别想象了强盗出现和其凶恶特征的可怕情景。
[P21] 两只小猫在穿过黑暗隧道时感到寒冷和恐惧，黄猫宝宝想象被绑架的可怕情景，但它们最终鼓起勇气，继续前行并成功穿过了隧道。
[P22] 两只小猫走进一片高高的荨麻丛，黄猫宝宝开始胡思乱想，担心迷路等可怕的事情，感到非常害怕。
[P23] 两只小猫在荨麻丛中继续前行，黄猫宝宝和蓝猫宝宝分别想象了邪恶猫巫婆念咒语将世界变成荨麻地的可怕情景，担心无法找到邮局，表现出对任务的持续焦虑。
[P24] 两只小猫穿过荨麻丛后来到高险的悬崖边，蓝猫宝宝开始胡思乱想，担心被偷走，表现出强烈的恐惧情绪。
[P25] 两只小猫在悬崖边继续前行，黄猫宝宝和蓝猫宝宝分别想象了被大鸟抓住并抓到高山鸟巢的可怕情景，表现出对未知危险的持续恐惧。
[P26] 黄猫宝宝在想象被大鸟抓走后，还要照顾和喂养其丑陋的宝宝，表现出对未知危险的恐惧和焦虑。
[P27] 两只小猫在悬崖边互相扶持前行，最终成功爬下悬崖，来到城里并轻松找到了邮局。
[P28] 两只小猫到达邮局，发现因猫总管生日而停业，无法寄出妈妈的信，感到非常沮丧和无助。
[P29] 两只小猫在邮局无法寄信后，一辆公共汽车驶来，猫外婆下车，小猫们惊喜地认出她，认为问题有了解决办法。
[P30] 两只小猫向猫外婆讲述了妈妈的信件内容和一路上的恐惧经历，猫外婆读信后得知信是写给自己的，信中邀请她来做客。
[P31] 猫外婆带着两只小猫宝宝去冰激凌店，每人买了一支鱼莓果冰激凌；同时，小猫们向猫外婆描述了路上的危险，猫外婆则带领他们前行，小猫们表示认识路。
[P32] 小猫们在猫外婆的陪伴下启程回家，虽然仍会胡思乱想，但已不再像之前那样害怕。
[P33] 画面中两只小猫背对背坐着，表情愉快，下方写着“完”字，标志着故事的结束。
